{
  "dataset_name": "led7",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "gpt-5.5-pro",
  "schema_version": "1.0.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "top_bar_on",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Numeric on/off indicator for the top LED bar encoded by attribute_1.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Keeps the top-bar state in a numeric scale suitable for SVM margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(((attribute_1 == 1) | (attribute_1 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "upper_left_bar_on",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Numeric on/off indicator for the upper-left LED bar encoded by attribute_2.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Preserves upper-left illumination as a direct linear input.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(((attribute_2 == 1) | (attribute_2 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "upper_right_bar_on",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Numeric on/off indicator for the upper-right LED bar encoded by attribute_3.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Preserves upper-right illumination as a direct linear input.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(((attribute_3 == 1) | (attribute_3 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "middle_bar_on",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Numeric on/off indicator for the middle LED bar encoded by attribute_4.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Makes the central split of the glyph directly available to the margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(((attribute_4 == 1) | (attribute_4 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "lower_left_bar_on",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Numeric on/off indicator for the lower-left LED bar encoded by attribute_5.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Preserves lower-left illumination, a sparse but informative segment state.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(((attribute_5 == 1) | (attribute_5 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "lower_right_bar_on",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Numeric on/off indicator for the lower-right LED bar encoded by attribute_6.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Preserves lower-right illumination, a frequent anchor segment for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(((attribute_6 == 1) | (attribute_6 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "bottom_bar_on",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Numeric on/off indicator for the bottom LED bar encoded by attribute_7.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_indicator",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Keeps bottom-bar evidence in a normalized numeric form.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(((attribute_7 == 1) | (attribute_7 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "lit_segment_fraction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of the seven LED segments that are on in the row.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_density",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Gives a smooth density axis for linear margins, separating sparse from heavily illuminated patterns.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(((attribute_1 == 1) | (attribute_1 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_2 == 1) | (attribute_2 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_3 == 1) | (attribute_3 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_4 == 1) | (attribute_4 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_5 == 1) | (attribute_5 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_6 == 1) | (attribute_6 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_7 == 1) | (attribute_7 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0)) / 7.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "complete_side_pair_fraction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Fraction of left and right vertical side pairs where both the upper and lower bars are on.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a low-order interaction for vertical continuity that a purely linear use of raw bits would not express directly.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.where(((attribute_2 == 1) | (attribute_2 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) * np.where(((attribute_5 == 1) | (attribute_5 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_3 == 1) | (attribute_3 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) * np.where(((attribute_6 == 1) | (attribute_6 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0)) / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "outer_loop_strength",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Interaction score for an outer-loop outline based on top, bottom, and side-bar illumination.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "segment_interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Summarizes closed-outline strength as a normalized composite useful for linear margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(((np.where(((attribute_1 == 1) | (attribute_1 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_7 == 1) | (attribute_7 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0)) / 2.0) * ((np.where(((attribute_2 == 1) | (attribute_2 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_3 == 1) | (attribute_3 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_5 == 1) | (attribute_5 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0) + np.where(((attribute_6 == 1) | (attribute_6 == '1')), 1.0, 0.0)) / 4.0))"
    },
    {
      "name": "glyph_plausibility_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score from 0.0 to 1.0 for how coherent and readable the on/off LED glyph appears under ordinary seven-segment display conventions.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_shape_prior",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Injects a smooth readability prior that can stabilize decisions when one segment is noisy.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "glyph_ambiguity_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic score from 0.0 to 1.0 estimating visual ambiguity among plausible seven-segment glyph interpretations; high values mean multiple readings seem similarly plausible.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_shape_prior",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a continuous uncertainty cue for rows near more than one valid-looking glyph, helping a linear SVM place less brittle margins.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
